text: There are five solutions. Two causes sit under them: the hours nobody uses overnight, and nobody owning the whole discharge.
None needs a new hospital system on day one. Each sheet shows what it still depends on.
chat.pointer: Pick a sheet to work through it, starting wherever matters most to you.
chat.note: Every solution is only as good as what it depends on.

points.label: Papers and bill that prepare themselves

prompts: Which one saves the most time?
Do we need to hire anyone?

blocks.title: Five solutions, two causes
blocks.deck: Each is drawn from a cause Diagnosis found. Open any sheet to see what it involves.

items.title: Start the going-home work on the evening round

cons.text: Doctors sign only an early summary at night
Decisions come any time from 6 to 9 PM

more_points: The doctor’s evening decision starts the discharge that night
Nurses, billing and pharmacy begin their part before morning
The family is told the night before
The doctor signs the final summary on the morning round

items.title: Papers and bill that prepare themselves

cons.text: Your IT team must link the hospital software
Typists move from typing to checking

more_points: The discharge summary is drafted from the day’s notes
The bill is kept up to date from admission
The supply count is worked out for the nurses
The insurance request goes out the evening before

items.title: One person in charge of discharge

cons.text: Helpers sized to your busy hours
Your Head of Operations must approve

more_points: One Discharge Manager owns every discharge, start to finish
Helpers are added for the busiest hours
They chase each step; they do not do each team’s work

items.title: Get the bed ready sooner after the patient leaves

cons.text: The bed desk needs real times

more_points: Housekeeping hears the moment the patient leaves
The bed desk sees cleaning start and finish
The next patient is called when the bed is ready

items.title: Separate discharge work from admission work

cons.text: Only needed if one team does both today

more_points: New patients arrive in the same hours discharges peak
One team doing both makes both wait
If separate teams exist today, this one is dropped
